exposure: Cord 25(OH)D levels: Deficiency (<12 ng/mL), Insufficiency (12-19 ng/mL), Optimum (20-100 ng/mL)
outcome: neonatal morbidities (respiratory distress, transient tachypnea, early-onset sepsis)
finding: Infants with low cord 25(OH)D levels had lower 25(OH)D values at 1 month and experienced higher rates of neonatal morbidities.
